# A Bit of Pixie Travel

> A Bit of Pixie Travel is the personal brand of Carey Richey, an independent travel advisor in Franklin, Indiana, affiliated with Best Day Ever Vacations. She plans Disney, Universal, and cruise vacations for families, couples, and small groups anywhere in the United States. Planning is free to travelers; she is compensated by travel partners.

## Services
- Disney vacations: Walt Disney World and Disneyland
- Universal vacations: Universal Orlando Resort and Universal Studios Hollywood
- Cruises: Disney Cruise Line, Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Norwegian, MSC, Carnival

## Credentials
- Disney College of Knowledge Graduate
- Universal Orlando Resort Specialist
- Universal Studios Hollywood Specialist
- Royal Caribbean certified travel advisor
- Norwegian Cruise Line NCLU Master's Degree
